title: Gift-Idea Conversion Before the Event
dataSources: Relationship check-ins (`relationship:checkin`), date nights (`datenight:log`), gift ideas (`giftidea:item`), keep-in-touch contacts (`keptintouch:contact`).
app: Relationship and togetherness logs — shared check-in apps, date-night and gift-idea lists, and stay-in-touch reminders — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=giftidea:item occasion=*
| stats count as ideas, sum(eval(if(status="bought",1,0))) as bought, sum(eval(if(status="wrapped",1,0))) as wrapped by occasion
| eval conversion_pct=round(100*bought/ideas,0), wrap_pct=round(100*wrapped/ideas,0)
| sort - conversion_pct
description: Measures how many gift ideas ever turn into an actual bought or wrapped present.
value: It is easy to mistake collecting ideas for making progress; conversion makes that gap visible.
implementation: Record each idea with a lifecycle status in `index=personal`; summarize conversion and wrap rates by occasion.
visualization: Table of occasions with idea count, bought count, and conversion percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces how many gift ideas ever become a real present instead of staying in a list forever.
